newsitem.title: MEXICO: Grupo Sanborns to replace Sanborn Hermanos.
newsitem.headline: Grupo Sanborns to replace Sanborn Hermanos.

text.p: Mexican retailer Grupo Sanborns said on Thursday that it would buy virtually all outstanding shares in Sanborn Hermanos to replace them with its own shares.

Grupo Sanborns, a subsidiary of conglomerate Grupo Carso, offered in a press statement to buy between Thursday and August 20 a total of 149,999,995 ordinary shares and 19,770,374 series L shares in Sanborn Hermanos at a price of 37 and 31.50 pesos, respectively.
The two share series account for 99.9999971 percent of Sanborn Hermanos' equity.
The statement added the purchase was conditional on sellers using the proceeds to subscribe to shares in Grupo Sanborns.
The lead manager in the deal is the Inversora Bursatil (Inbursa) brokerage.
